account_exists.cause: An account already uses this email address.
account_exists.next: Sign in with that account and accept the invitation from there.

account_not_found.cause: The account was removed, or the list is out of date.

already_member.cause: That person already belongs to this team.
already_member.next: Change their role from the members list instead.

archive_bomb.cause: The entry claims a compression ratio no real file has: it looks like a decompression bomb.
archive_bomb.next: Do not extract it; download the archive only if you trust where it came from.

archive_encrypted.cause: The archive, or this entry, is protected with a password.
archive_encrypted.next: Download it and open it with an archiver that asks for the password.

archive_entry_not_found.cause: The archive has no file with that name any more.
archive_entry_not_found.next: Reload the archive to see what it holds now.

archive_too_large.cause: The entry, or the archive nested around it, is bigger than the viewer reads.
archive_too_large.next: Download the archive and extract it on your computer.

archive_unsupported.cause: The file is not an archive the viewer reads, or it is damaged.
archive_unsupported.next: Download it and open it with an archiver.

bookmark_limit_reached.cause: A site keeps at most 200 bookmarks.
bookmark_limit_reached.next: Remove bookmarks you no longer use.

bookmark_name_taken.cause: This site already has a bookmark with that name, whatever its case.
bookmark_name_taken.next: Choose another name or rename the existing bookmark.

bookmark_not_found.cause: The bookmark was removed, perhaps from another tab or by a teammate.

ceremony_expired.cause: The passkey request took too long or was started elsewhere.

checksum_mismatch.cause: The file changed on the server during the transfer, or the data was damaged on the way.
checksum_mismatch.next: Transfer the file again and compare the checksums.

collection_cycle.cause: A collection cannot go inside itself or one of its own collections.
collection_cycle.next: Choose a collection outside the one you are moving.

collection_name_taken.cause: Another collection at the same level already has that name.
collection_name_taken.next: Choose another name, or put it in another collection.

collection_not_empty.cause: The collection still holds sites or collections.
collection_not_empty.next: Move or delete what is inside first.

collection_not_found.cause: The collection was removed, perhaps from another tab or by a teammate.

collection_too_deep.cause: Collections nest at most 12 levels deep.
collection_too_deep.next: Put it in a collection nearer the top.

connector_disabled.cause: An administrator of this instance stopped offering this kind of site.
connector_disabled.next: Ask an administrator to offer its connector again in Settings → Administration → Connectors.

connector_not_found.cause: This connector is not part of this version of Transferly.
connector_not_found.next: Reload the page to see the connectors this version has.

credentials_not_asked.cause: This site stores its password, so it does not ask for one when connecting.
credentials_not_asked.next: Edit the site to change its password or its logon type.

credentials_required.cause: The site asks for its password when connecting and none was given in this session.

cross_site_request.cause: The request came from a page of another site, which Transferly refuses to protect your session.
cross_site_request.next: Use Transferly from its own address.

csrf_invalid.cause: The page is older than your current session, or the session changed in another tab.
csrf_invalid.next: Reload the page and try again.

daily_quota_reached.cause: The workspace moved all the data the administrator allows per day.
daily_quota_reached.next: Wait until tomorrow or ask an administrator to raise the quota.

destination_blocked.cause: The network policy of this Transferly does not allow reaching that address.
destination_blocked.next: Check the address, or ask an administrator to allow its network.

directory_not_empty.cause: The folder still has files, and the server only removes empty folders this way.
directory_not_empty.next: Delete its contents first, or delete it with everything inside.

elevation_forbidden.cause: Turning on sudo, or changing a site that has it on, is kept for the admins of the workspace.
elevation_forbidden.next: Ask an admin of the workspace to do it.

empty_patch.cause: The change had nothing to change.
empty_patch.next: Choose at least one setting to change.

forbidden.cause: Your role does not allow this here.
forbidden.next: Ask an owner or administrator of the workspace.

host_key_changed.cause: The server presents a key other than the trusted one: it was reinstalled, or someone is intercepting the connection.
host_key_changed.next: Confirm the new key with the server's administrator before trusting it.

host_key_not_found.cause: The key is no longer trusted, perhaps forgotten from another tab.

host_key_unknown.cause: This is the first connection to the server, so its key is not trusted yet.
host_key_unknown.next: Compare the fingerprint with the one the server's administrator gives you, then trust it.

host_unresolvable.cause: The host name does not exist or the DNS did not answer.
host_unresolvable.next: Check the spelling of the host, or use its IP address.

import_file_too_large.cause: The file is over 4 MiB, far more than any list of sites needs.
import_file_too_large.next: Check that you chose the right file.

internal_error.cause: Something failed inside Transferly; nothing about your request was wrong.
internal_error.next: Try again; if it keeps failing, tell your administrator the time it happened.

invalid_answers.cause: The answers did not match the server's questions, or one was too long.

invalid_auth_method.cause: That logon type does not exist for this protocol, such as a key file for FTP.
invalid_auth_method.next: Choose a logon type the protocol offers.

invalid_bookmark_name.cause: The name is empty or longer than 200 characters.
invalid_bookmark_name.next: Give the bookmark a shorter name.

invalid_bookmark_path.cause: A bookmark needs an absolute folder path, starting with /.
invalid_bookmark_path.next: Write the full path of the folder.

invalid_challenge.cause: The sign-in step expired or was already used.
invalid_challenge.next: Sign in again from the start.

invalid_charset.cause: That character set is unknown, or the protocol only uses UTF-8.
invalid_charset.next: Choose a character set from the list; SFTP always uses UTF-8.

invalid_code.cause: The code is wrong or expired; codes change every 30 seconds.
invalid_code.next: Check the clock of your device and enter the current code.

invalid_color.cause: The label color is not one Transferly offers.
invalid_color.next: Pick one of the colors of the list, or none.

invalid_config.cause: A setting of the site does not follow what its kind of server expects, such as a port out of range or an option it does not offer.
invalid_config.next: Correct the field the form marks and save again.

invalid_credentials.cause: The email or the password is wrong.
invalid_credentials.next: Check both; after several attempts you have to wait a moment.

invalid_email.cause: The email address is not valid.

invalid_export.cause: The file is not an export of Transferly, or was made by a newer version.
invalid_export.next: Choose the file the export downloaded.

invalid_filter.cause: A filter of the trail has a value it does not know.
invalid_filter.next: Clear the filters and choose them again.

invalid_ftp_encryption.cause: That encryption does not exist for FTP.
invalid_ftp_encryption.next: Choose one of the encryptions offered.

invalid_host.cause: The host is empty or has characters a server name cannot have.
invalid_host.next: Write only the name or address, without ftp:// or a path.

invalid_host_key.cause: The key type or fingerprint is not one Transferly accepts.
invalid_host_key.next: Trust the key from the connection that shows it.

invalid_import_file.cause: The file is not a sitemanager.xml of FileZilla, or it is damaged.
invalid_import_file.next: Export the site manager again from FileZilla and choose that file.

invalid_jump.cause: The jump host is incomplete, or the site is not SFTP.
invalid_jump.next: Give the jump host its host, port and username, or remove it.

invalid_limits.cause: A limit is negative or too large.
invalid_limits.next: Use zero for no limit, or a smaller value.

invalid_mode.cause: The upload asked for a way of writing the file that does not exist.
invalid_mode.next: Choose again what to do with the file that exists.

invalid_name.cause: The name is empty or too long.
invalid_name.next: Give it a name of at most 200 characters.

invalid_network.cause: That is not a network in CIDR notation, such as 10.0.0.0/8.
invalid_network.next: Write the network with its prefix length.

invalid_offset.cause: A resumed upload started at a point the file does not reach.
invalid_offset.next: Upload the file again from the start.

invalid_passkey.cause: The passkey was not accepted: it belongs to another site or account, or the browser canceled.
invalid_passkey.next: Try again with a passkey of this account.

invalid_password.cause: The password of your account is wrong.
invalid_password.next: Enter the password you sign in with.

browser_session_required.cause: Only the web interface, signed in in the browser, can approve a sign-in of the terminal client.
browser_session_required.next: Open the approval link in your browser and approve it there.

ambiguous_credentials.cause: The request carried both the session cookie and a bearer token, and the server accepts only one.
ambiguous_credentials.next: Send the bearer token alone from the terminal client, or sign in again in the browser.

cli_link_not_found.cause: The sign-in link is wrong or expired; links last 10 minutes.
cli_link_not_found.next: Start the sign-in again from the terminal and open the link it shows.

cli_login_disabled.cause: Signing in from the terminal client is turned off on this server.
cli_login_disabled.next: Ask the administrator of the server to turn it on (TRANSFERLY_CLI_LOGIN).

invalid_cli_request.cause: The sign-in request of the terminal client is malformed.
invalid_cli_request.next: Start the sign-in again from the terminal; if it keeps failing, update transferly-tui.

invalid_grant.cause: The sign-in code is wrong, was already used or expired; codes last 5 minutes.
invalid_grant.next: Start the sign-in again from the terminal and approve the new request.

invalid_redirect.cause: The terminal client asked to send the code somewhere other than this computer.
invalid_redirect.next: Approve only sign-ins you started yourself, and start it again from the terminal.

session_not_found.cause: That session already ended or belongs to another account.

invalid_path.cause: The path is empty, relative, or has characters the server refuses.
invalid_path.next: Use an absolute path, starting with /.

invalid_port.cause: The port is not between 1 and 65535.
invalid_port.next: Leave it empty for the protocol's default port.

invalid_priority.next: Move the transfer from the queue again.

invalid_proxy.cause: The proxy is incomplete or of an unknown kind.
invalid_proxy.next: Give the proxy its kind, host and port, or remove it.

invalid_remote_dir.cause: The default folder is relative, too long or has control characters.
invalid_remote_dir.next: Write an absolute path, or leave it empty for the root.

invalid_request.cause: The request was malformed or too large, usually because the page is out of date.
invalid_request.next: Reload the page and try again.

invalid_role.cause: That role does not exist, or cannot be given this way.
invalid_role.next: Choose one of the roles offered.

invalid_secret.cause: The master password or the recovery kit is wrong.
invalid_secret.next: Check the master password; if you lost it, use the recovery kit.

invalid_size.cause: The upload announced a size that does not match its data.

invalid_speed_limit.cause: The speed limit is negative or too large.

invalid_timezone.next: Choose a zone from the list, such as UTC or America/Santiago.

invalid_username.cause: The username is empty or too long.
invalid_username.next: Write the account name the server gave you.

invitation_not_found.cause: The invitation expired, was revoked, or is for another email address.

last_admin.cause: The instance always keeps at least one administrator.
last_admin.next: Make someone else an administrator first.

member_not_found.cause: That person no longer belongs to the team.

member_quota_reached.cause: The team has all the members the administrator allows.
member_quota_reached.next: Remove a member or ask an administrator to raise the limit.

method_not_allowed.cause: That address does not take this kind of request, usually because the page is out of date.

network_error.cause: Transferly did not answer: your connection dropped or the server is restarting.
network_error.next: Check your connection and try again.

no_passkeys.cause: This account has no passkeys yet.
no_passkeys.next: Sign in with your password, then add a passkey in Security.

not_a_directory.cause: The path is a file, not a folder.
not_a_directory.next: Open the folder that holds it.

not_found.cause: That address does not exist, usually because the page is out of date.

oauth_not_configured.cause: This instance has no OAuth client registered with Google, which signing in with Google needs.
oauth_not_configured.next: Ask an administrator to register one in Google Cloud and set TRANSFERLY_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and TRANSFERLY_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.

own_account.cause: Administrators cannot change or disable their own account here.

owner_bound.cause: The owner of a team cannot be removed, change role or leave.
owner_bound.next: Transfer the ownership to another member first.

passphrase_required.cause: The private key is encrypted and no passphrase was given.
passphrase_required.next: Enter the passphrase of the key.

password_required.cause: A site that asks for its password needs one to be typed.

path_exists.cause: A file or folder with that name already exists there.
path_exists.next: Choose another name, or delete or rename the existing one.

path_not_found.cause: The file or folder does not exist: it was moved, renamed or deleted on the server.

personal_workspace.cause: A personal workspace has only you, so it cannot have members, be renamed or be deleted.
personal_workspace.next: Create a team to work with others.

private_key_is_public.cause: The file holds a public key, the one that goes on the server.
private_key_is_public.next: Choose the private key, usually the file without .pub.

private_key_unreadable.cause: The file is not a private key Transferly can read.
private_key_unreadable.next: Choose an OpenSSH, PEM or PuTTY key file.

private_key_unsupported.cause: The key uses a type or protection Transferly does not use, such as DSA.
private_key_unsupported.next: Create an Ed25519 or RSA key and install it on the server.

prompt_not_found.cause: The connection stopped waiting: it was answered in another tab, canceled, or took too long.

quick_connection_not_found.cause: The quick connection closed, since they last only for your session.
quick_connection_not_found.next: Connect again, or save the server as a site.

range_not_satisfiable.cause: The file on the server is shorter than the part asked for; it changed since the transfer started.
range_not_satisfiable.next: Download the file again from the start.

rate_limited.cause: Too many attempts in a short time.
rate_limited.next: Wait a minute and try again.

remote_auth_failed.cause: The server refused the username, password or key.
remote_auth_failed.next: Check the credentials of the site; the server may also lock accounts after failed attempts.

remote_permission_denied.cause: The server account has no permission for this file or folder.
remote_permission_denied.next: Ask the server's administrator for access, or use another folder.

remote_quota_exceeded.cause: The server account or its disk is full.
remote_quota_exceeded.next: Free space on the server or ask its administrator for more.

remote_unavailable.cause: The server did not answer, closed the connection, or is not reachable from Transferly.
remote_unavailable.next: Check the host and port, and that the server is on; then try again.

secret_too_large.cause: The password or key is larger than any real one.
secret_too_large.next: Check that you pasted only the secret.

server_commands_unsupported.cause: The server does not let the account run commands, lacks the tool, or an administrator turned commands off.
server_commands_unsupported.next: Use the operation without the server: download and upload, or ask an administrator to allow server commands in Administration → Limits.

setup_complete.cause: This Transferly already has an administrator.

site_name_taken.cause: Another site of the same collection already has that name, whatever its case. Sites in other collections may share it.

site_not_found.cause: The site was deleted, perhaps from another tab or by a teammate.

site_quota_reached.cause: The workspace has all the sites the administrator allows.
site_quota_reached.next: Delete sites you no longer use, or ask an administrator to raise the limit.

sudo_refused.cause: sudo refused to run the session as the chosen user: the password is wrong or missing, the account may not use sudo, or the server runs no commands.
sudo_refused.next: Check the sudo password of the site and that the account is in the sudoers of the server.

team_quota_reached.cause: You own all the teams the administrator allows.
team_quota_reached.next: Delete a team or ask an administrator to raise the limit.

terminal_off.cause: The site does not have its terminal turned on.
terminal_off.next: Ask an admin of the workspace to turn on Allow the terminal in the Advanced tab of the site.

time_zone_inconclusive.cause: The server's listing did not show enough to tell its time zone.
time_zone_inconclusive.next: Choose the zone of the site by hand; most servers use UTC.

too_many_invitations.cause: The team has too many open invitations.
too_many_invitations.next: Revoke invitations that were not accepted.

too_many_networks.cause: The instance allows a limited number of networks.
too_many_networks.next: Remove networks that are no longer needed.

too_many_passkeys.cause: An account keeps a limited number of passkeys.
too_many_passkeys.next: Remove passkeys of devices you no longer use.

too_many_quick_connections.cause: You have too many quick connections open at once.
too_many_quick_connections.next: Close one, or save the servers you use as sites.

totp_not_enabled.cause: Your account has no authenticator app set up.
totp_not_enabled.next: Set up the second factor first.

totp_not_started.cause: The setup of the authenticator app was not started or expired.
totp_not_started.next: Start setting up the second factor again.

transfer_active.next: Cancel it first, or wait until it ends.

transfer_canceled.cause: The transfer was canceled before it ended.
transfer_canceled.next: Start it again if you still need it.

transfer_id_taken.cause: Another transfer already uses that identifier, usually a double click.
transfer_id_taken.next: Check the queue; the transfer is probably already there.

transfer_not_active.next: Look at its result in the queue.

transfer_not_found.cause: The transfer is no longer in the history.

transfer_not_queued.cause: Only transfers still waiting can be moved.
transfer_not_queued.next: Wait for it to end, or cancel it.

tree_too_large.cause: The folder holds more files than one operation takes.
tree_too_large.next: Work on its subfolders one at a time.

unauthenticated.cause: Your session ended: you signed out, or it was idle too long.

unsupported_algorithm.cause: The server does not compute that checksum.

user_disabled.next: Ask an administrator of this Transferly.

vault_exists.cause: Your vault is already set up.
vault_exists.next: Unlock it with your master password.

vault_locked.cause: Passwords and keys are sealed in your vault, which is locked in this session.
vault_locked.next: Unlock the vault with your master password.

vault_not_initialized.next: Set up the vault with a master password.

weak_export_password.cause: The file password has fewer than 12 characters.
weak_export_password.next: Choose a longer password, such as a sentence.

weak_password.cause: The password has fewer than 12 characters.
weak_password.next: Choose a longer password, such as a sentence.

workspace_key_pending.cause: The key of this team was not shared with you yet; an owner does it once your vault is set up.
workspace_key_pending.next: Ask an owner of the team to open Transferly with the vault unlocked.

workspace_not_found.cause: The workspace was deleted, or you no longer belong to it.

wrong_export_password.cause: The password is not the one of the file, or the file was changed after the export.
wrong_export_password.next: Enter the password chosen when exporting.

wrong_passphrase.cause: The passphrase does not open the private key.
wrong_passphrase.next: Check the passphrase of the key.

safe_replace_unsupported.cause: The server does not provide a safe replacement operation. The original file was preserved.
safe_replace_unsupported.next: Save the new file under a different name or use a server supporting atomic replacement.

copy_connection_limit.cause: Copying this file needs two connections.
copy_connection_limit.next: Increase the site connection limit, or download and upload the file.

ssh_algorithm_incompatible.next: Ask the server administrator to enable secure SSH algorithms. Automatic retries cannot resolve this incompatibility.

remote_connection_timeout.cause: The server did not respond before the connection deadline. Access may be blocked, or the server or network may be unavailable.
remote_connection_timeout.next: Automatic attempts have stopped. Check the host, port, network and IP allowlist before retrying manually.
